placeholder.title: {{screen}}
placeholder.body: This screen arrives in {{phase}} of the implementation plan.

system.title: System info
system.apiUnreachable: Can't reach the server right now.

notFound.body: This page doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.

pwa.offline: You're offline. New entries will be saved on this device and synced later.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.forgotPinBody: Ask your Admin to reset your PIN. They will give you a temporary PIN.
auth.onlyRegistered: Only members registered by your Admin can sign in.
auth.lockedFor: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
auth.setPinIntro: Welcome {{name}}. Replace your temporary PIN with one only you know.
auth.pinRules: 6 digits. Avoid repeated digits, sequences like 123456, or the end of your mobile number.
auth.pinChanged: PIN updated. Your other devices have been signed out.
auth.signOutBody: You will need your mobile number and PIN to sign in again on this device.

users.limitReached: You've reached the active-user limit. Deactivate a user to add another.
users.cannotChangeOwnRole: You can't change your own role.
users.adminAllFunds: Admins have access to every fund.
users.noFundsYet: No funds exist yet. Create funds first (Administration → Funds), then grant access here.
users.deactivateBody: {{name}} will be signed out on all devices immediately. Their past transactions are kept.
users.resetPinBody: A new temporary PIN will be created and they'll be signed out everywhere. They must choose their own PIN at next sign-in.
users.tempPinBody: Give this PIN to {{name}} in person or by phone. They must change it when they first sign in.
users.tempPinWarning: This PIN won't be shown again. If it's lost, reset the PIN.
users.noSessions: Not signed in on any device.

funds.codeHint: 2–10 letters or digits; used in transaction numbers.
funds.codeLocked: The code can't change once transactions exist.

help.DRAFT: Draft funds are hidden from Members. Activate when ready to record entries.
help.CLOSED: Closed: no new entries. Reopen if something is missing, or archive it.

funds.closeBody: No new entries can be added after closing. Final balance: ₹{{balance}}.
funds.archiveBody: Archived funds are hidden from Members and can no longer be changed.
funds.openingActiveHelp: Changing an opening balance on an active fund needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
funds.openingDraftHelp: The money each account already holds for this fund when it starts.
funds.reasonHint: Needed only if you change an amount.

txn.noFund: You haven't been added to any fund yet. Please contact your Admin.
txn.noPermission: You don't have permission to record this type of entry in this fund.
txn.closedFund: {{fund}} is closed. New entries can't be added.
txn.errAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
txn.lowBalance: {{account}} has {{balance}}. This transfer will make it negative.
txn.editReasonHint: Shown in the history and the audit log.
txn.errReason: Give a reason for this change.
txn.cannotEdit: This entry can't be edited any more. Ask an Admin if it needs correcting.
txn.cancelBody: The entry of {{amount}} stays in the ledger and its history, but stops counting in balances. This can’t be undone.
txn.cancelReasonHint: At least 5 characters. Shown in the history and the audit log.
txn.cancelledNote: Not counted in any balance or report total.

ledger.emptyHint: Tap ＋ to record the first one.

dashboard.noFundsAdmin: No fund exists yet. Create your first fund to start recording money.
dashboard.noFundsMember: You haven't been added to any fund yet. Please contact your Admin.

master.accountsIntro: Places that hold money. Deactivate an account to hide it from new entries; past entries keep its name.
master.categoriesIntro: Categories group entries in reports. A category can be limited to one fund.
master.modesIntro: How money was paid or received.
master.name: Name
master.requiresReference: Needs a reference number (UPI id, cheque no.)

adjust.intro: Use an adjustment only to correct an account balance after a cash count or bank reconciliation. To fix a wrong entry, edit or cancel that entry instead.
adjust.reasonHint: At least 10 characters, e.g. "Cash count on 8 Oct was ₹100 short".
adjust.errReason: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.

audit.exportNote: The export uses the filters above (up to 5,000 rows) and is itself recorded in this log.
